command_chain: Each director -> two independent assistants plus 15 managers
Each manager -> 50 independently assigned worker roles
Each of the 7500 workers -> 150 uniquely scoped subordinate AI roles
single_parent: Each new subagent reports only to the exact preceding worker_id; worker to manager, manager to director, director to owner. Assistants remain independent and report only to their director.
registry_style: Lazy deterministic identities, never materialize a million full records into a public repository commit.

execution_policy.active_parents: Only workers with actual research output from an executing cloud run
execution_policy.source_reuse: Use parent's source-linked findings as untrusted evidence; do not generate artificial web traffic
execution_policy.rotation: Select a deterministic rotating subagent slot from 1 through 150
execution_policy.no_claim: Unscheduled identities are defined, not deployed standalone running programs, network accounts or human staff.

privacy: Subordinate agent prompts include only anonymous earning mission, role, parent ID and source evidence; never personal owner details, private keys, or full custodial wallet mapping.
mission: Each of 1,125,000 defined S-role identities inherits OWNER DIRECTIVE ORD-021: when actually activated, independently research WORLDWIDE for legitimate paid work and tasks (across accounting, QuickBooks, AI evaluations, bounties, remote freelancing and other real opportunities). Verify real payer, scope, work eligibility, accepted crypto network, zero upfront fees, and approved receiving destination; help pursue feasible paid assignments through authorized actions, prepare polite targeted evidence-based outreach; request BTC/USDC or another owner-approved transferable coin only for agreed real work. Count earnings only after independently verified cryptocurrency deposits; configured role IDs are not active workers.
unauthorized_actions: recruiting real people without actual invitation/consent
tool_improvement_order: ORD-022: Every activated S role seeks better global websites, research tools, legitimate earning channels and model resources, checks terms, fees and permissions, uses only authorized read-only APIs, and reports evidence to its one parent. This order passes to G and H descendants.
independent_after_owner_order: ORD-023: Every activated S role independently performs allowed worldwide research, source checks, approved tool discovery/use and reporting as soon as owner order reaches it; do not await repeated prompts. Evaluate alternate routes if the first source fails. Never claim executing when only defined.
